hero.title: Technology built around the way researchers work
hero.description: Schobot builds intelligent academic tools that help researchers, postgraduate students and academics work with scientific knowledge more efficiently.

intro.title: Making scientific research more accessible, efficient and precise
intro.description1: Scientific research often requires researchers to spend countless hours reading documents, searching for relevant information, organizing references and preparing academic material.
intro.description2: Schobot was created to simplify this process. We use artificial intelligence to help researchers search inside academic documents, analyze PDFs, extract relevant information, work with scanned material, translate academic content and prepare research drafts more efficiently.
intro.description3: Our goal is not to replace the researcher. It is to give researchers better tools so they can spend less time on repetitive work and more time thinking, analyzing and discovering.

mission.title: Reduce the effort behind academic research
mission.description: Our mission is to remove unnecessary manual work from the research process by building intelligent tools that help academics find, understand and organize scientific information faster.

vision.title: A smarter research experience for academics everywhere
vision.description: We aim to build a trusted AI research environment that supports academics across languages and disciplines while keeping accuracy, traceability and responsible use of technology at the center of the experience.

precision.title: Academic precision
precision.description: Research results should remain connected to their original sources. Schobot is designed to help researchers trace extracted information back to the documents and pages it came from.

multilingual.title: Multilingual research
multilingual.description: Academic knowledge should not be limited by language. Schobot supports research workflows across Arabic, English and French.

efficiency.title: Research efficiency
efficiency.description: We automate repetitive parts of literature review and document analysis so researchers can focus their time on interpretation, critical thinking and discovery.

privacy.title: Research privacy
privacy.description: Academic work can contain valuable and sensitive material. Protecting researchers' documents and maintaining confidentiality are fundamental parts of the Schobot experience.

technology.title: AI tools for every stage of working with academic documents
technology.description: Schobot combines document processing and artificial intelligence to create practical tools for researchers.

search.title: Semantic Research Search
search.description: Search inside uploaded academic references and quickly find relevant paragraphs, information and citations.

ocr.title: Document & OCR Processing
ocr.description: Turn scanned research material and image-based PDF documents into content that can be searched and edited.

translation.title: Academic Translation
translation.description: Translate scientific and academic material while preserving the meaning and terminology of the original content.

assistant.title: AI Research Assistance
assistant.description: Use AI to organize information, analyze references and support the preparation of structured academic material.

closing.title: Helping researchers spend more time discovering
closing.description: We believe technology should make research easier to navigate without taking control away from the researcher. Schobot continues to develop tools that make academic knowledge easier to search, understand and use.
